findings.risk: Individually ordinary fragments could reconstruct participation or attendance.
The combination could reveal Jamie's filesystem, correspondence, or protected research corpus.
The fragments could expose applicant or grantee financial context.
A professional case study could unnecessarily encode private family circumstances.

Aggregate archive accounting could become reconstructable participant, strategy, or role evidence if exact locators or item metadata were projected publicly.
